final: WITH g AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS zoneref, s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(f.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures f JOIN sites s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT zoneref, entrystat, avg_traitcount, record_count, CAST(record_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM g) AS fraction FROM g ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
